findings.observation: The pre-activation realtime checkpoint path can cancel checkpoint_files after the cloud transaction begins instead of latching terminal state through reconciliation.
findings.impact: Prepare or finalize may commit remotely while local revision remains stale, causing later conflict or data loss.
findings.recommendation: Limit the deadline to grant/save correlation; once prepare begins, drive idempotent cloud reconciliation to a conclusive result while bounding/latching other inputs, then handle terminal state.
evidence: checkpoint_files is raced against the original deadline
reset/control/realtime terminal branches can also drop it
the existing invariant says prepare must not be cancelled after it begins

findings.observation: The round-robin test does not hold control, realtime, and due heartbeat ready at the same arbitration points.
findings.impact: A regression to the previous multi-source starvation shape could pass after finite producers drain.
findings.recommendation: Use barriers or sustained producers to hold all sources ready and assert bounded C/R/H rotation.
evidence: test queues only Ready and one Spawn
assertions are eventual booleans rather than bounded selection order

findings.observation: R3 covers interaction overflow but not launcher lifecycle-output enqueue backpressure through the production activation path.
findings.impact: Lifecycle mapping/backpressure cleanup can regress without activation-level failure.
findings.recommendation: Stall ROM control reads, fill lifecycle output after activation, and assert terminal joined cleanup and no remint/trailing output.
